citations.assessment: Shabbat names Chalafta among Yosi’s sons. Moed Katan narrates the death without naming the son. Heilprin’s headed Yosi dossier names him and discusses the difference with Semachot.

citations.assessment: Yuchasin explicitly names Chalafta as the son whose death preceded his father’s. The checked Semachot passage gives an account referring generally to a son; Moed Katan leaves the name unspoken. Retain the attributed identification with this qualification.
